replies.body:
Please get off of Nova's case, even if he is being rude to you; you have no reason to further arguing. By instating and furthering your unnecessary arguments you further the bad reputation you are making yourself. Nova has already been warned countless time and in exchange was banned. Whether he has been appealed or not is besides the point, he has been banned. He received a punishment; however, I will see why he was appealed as I banned him. Anyways, if you could kindly stop reporting Nova that would be great. Stop insuing arguments by arguing with him, thanks.

Cheers,
Iron.
